resolution: The render-counter (req_1968) named the exact culprits: 're-rendered: Chrome,RightPanel' on every place. Fixed the two unstable-prop bugs that were silently no-op'ing the memos. (1) scopeBuildEvent in useBuildUndo depended on streamState + buildingsState, which change on every commit — so commitBuildEvent/commitBuildEvents got a fresh identity each place and re-rendered every panel that takes them (RightPanel's onPaintCommit, LoaderIsoView's onCommit, etc.). Now it reads those via refs (streamStateRef/buildingsStateRef) with deps [stem, legacyPieceMapName], stable on a place; behavior identical. (2) Chrome (the shell bar) wasn't memoized and its ~8 nav handlers were inline arrows (fresh every render); memoized Chrome + hoisted the nav handlers to stable useCallbacks (goHome/goEditor/... onNewMap). Since host-block is GC produced by this very re-render, eliminating it should drop pre AND host-block together. The render-counter is left in to confirm on the next place. Bundle clean, cart-side hot-reload. Sha 6341e1b92.
